description: LINES operationalizes a lean-resilience assessment using network topology, passenger flows and demand over a parameterized period. The implemented Lisbon bus, tram and subway application detects vulnerabilities from the interaction of multimodal structure and changing use. It is distinct from the related static/topological node-removal robustness study, even though both arise from the same broader thesis. The catalogue records CARRIS and METRO validations as used inputs. Source metadata do not identify a standalone public implementation or quantify all validation outcomes, so those fields remain unknown. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
